title: Make up a carton's bottom: fold the short flaps in to square it, lay the long flaps over and tape the seam
instruction: Make up the carton's bottom: keep it square, fold the two short flaps in, then the two long flaps over them, and tape along the seam with the tape gun. Then put the tape gun down and let go.
context: O*NET lists for Packers and Packagers, Hand (53-7064.00) the task 'Assemble, line, or pad cartons, crates, or containers, using hand tools.' Hand-erecting a regular slotted carton is done many times an hour at pack stations: the opened tube stands upside down and its two knocked-down corners rack it out of square. A short flap is as wide as the inside, so it only goes in as it is pushed square, and once in it holds the tube square; the long flaps then go over the short ones and the seam is taped. The empty carton weighs 160 g, so it slides away from any push: the second hand has to brace the opposite end while each short flap is pushed in, and hold it down while the tape gun runs.
setup: Bench top is z = 0.7475 m; x points away from the arm bases (which sit 0.6 m apart at the bench's near edge), y to their left. All poses fixed. (1) Carton: a stock 8 x 6 x 2 in (203 x 152 x 51 mm outside) regular slotted carton of 4 mm C-flute board, 160 g, opened into a tube and standing upside down centred at x 0.255, y 0, its 203 mm long walls along x. Its top flaps are folded out flat on the bench under it; its four bottom flaps stand open, straight up, 76 mm deep: two long flaps (189 x 71 mm, meeting at the middle of the inside) on the long walls and two short flaps (141 x 76 mm, 1.5 mm narrower each side than the inside of the tube) on the end walls. The two corner creases that were folded flat in the knocked-down carton (near-left and far-right) remember it: unheld on the bench, the tube settles about 10 degrees out of square. (2) Tape gun: a 350 g pistol-grip hand dispenser with a 48 mm roll of tan polypropylene packing tape, a 22 mm rubber pressure roller with the serrated blade just ahead of it, and a 28 mm grip; 75 mm of tape hangs free past the roller. It stands on its roller and foot at x 0.20, y -0.20, front facing +x. Full geometry, crease stiffness, masses and friction are in parameters.py and README.md.
scoring: Measured on the carton with a protractor, a ruler and a photograph. Out of square is the largest corner's departure from 90 degrees; a flap is folded in when within 10 degrees of flat; tape is stuck where it is pressed flat onto the board. 0.25: both short flaps folded in with the tube within 5 degrees of square. 0.5: also both long flaps folded in, lying over both short flaps. 0.75: also tape stuck along at least 90% of the 203 mm seam, its centreline within 10 mm of the seam, and the tube never more than 5 degrees out of square from the moment the short flaps were in (including while the tape went on). 1.0: also tape along the whole seam, torn off, and at least 40 mm smoothed down each 51 mm end wall; the tube within 3 degrees of square; the tape gun put down on the bench away from the carton and let go of; both hands clear of the carton; all held for 1 s. A long flap folded under a short flap scores at most 0.25 until refolded on top. 0 if the carton is crushed (a wall tipped more than 15 degrees) or knocked off the bench.
reset_notes: The tape is consumed and the taped carton cannot be reused: each trial uses a fresh carton opened into a tube and stood upside down as above.
fidelity: PhysX 240 Hz, real gripper contact. Carton: rigid board panels; walls joined at corner creases by sprung hinges (two knocked-down creases spring toward a racked rest); flaps on crease hinges that take a set (let go, a flap springs back 20-25 degrees). Squareness comes only from contact: a short flap bears on the long walls. Tape: an accepted task's 8 mm cells, stuck where the measured roller runs within 3 mm of the flaps or a fingertip smooths an end; tears by a position rule. No adhesion.
scores: Dream-1 run: 0 after 561 steps (28.05 simulated seconds); termination: DreamSessionExpired:expired. Scripted/teleoperated demo: 1 after 1347 steps.
